exact_maps.full_qk: Actual independently parameterized query/key FactorLinear sigmoid outputs

capture.local_selected_policy: Record not_executed/not_applicable for each unexecuted global slot; never force a global pass and never replace this status by zero.
capture.method_constraint: Copy/detach sampled rows without changing Q/K/X, tensors/parameters, selected stage or serving prediction. A generic Linear hook alone is insufficient for functional split/active pair code.
capture.observer_labels_logits_checkpoints_outco: None. The observer receives only captured rows and actual execution/slot metadata from the already admitted reader; it performs no restore or extra member call.
capture.site: Actual post-feature-map Q/K pair, before native KV contractions, for each executing global layer/head.

conformance_and_decisions.reference_residual_policy: A material residual prompts source/capture/arithmetic provenance review; it does not authorize a tiny-float chase, changed recipe or inference rerun.

cycle_statistic.affinity: C_ij = dot(q_i,k_j), with original all-node attention core entries; do not renormalize the sampled rows.
cycle_statistic.arithmetic: Float64 dot products and logs from exactly captured float32 Q/K rows; chunks of 64 samples.
cycle_statistic.exact_arithmetic_fact: For a strictly positive complete core, all triangle residuals vanish iff its row-normalized kernel is reversible. An exact nonzero sampled residual is a witness; sampled zeros do not certify reversibility.
cycle_statistic.floating_claim_policy: Report floating magnitudes and provenance. A resolved mathematical witness additionally requires a separately prospective reviewed arithmetic-error policy; no certificate or significance cutoff is supplied here.
cycle_statistic.inferential_scope: Intrinsic conditional magnitudes; no node-iid test, member/seed independence inference, predictive competence or mediation.
cycle_statistic.normalizers: Full original row denominators cancel exactly around the cycle.
cycle_statistic.report_unit: One record per actual selected member/layer/head, with actual selected mode and all fixed sample/failure counts.

invalid_policy.features_nonfinite: Retain capture failure and unavailable slot; no replacement.
invalid_policy.required_score_nonpositive_or_nonfinite: The corresponding complete-slot aggregate is unavailable; retain fixed sample counts and each failure count. Cycle and optional pair availability are separate.

optional_pair_gram_obstruction.exact_arithmetic_fact: Positive weighted Gram affinities obey L_ij>=0 by Cauchy–Schwarz. An exact negative value excludes that Gram class.
limitations: It does not by itself prove a negative eigenvalue of the full large kernel.
It is not a reversibility test.
Floating negative values require precision qualification.
optional_pair_gram_obstruction.status: Separate optional descriptive diagnostic; not a second predictive gate.

requires_before_any_observation: Separate frozen root/source review and observer cost admission.
Exact sampling implementation and generated index list sealed before comparative outcome access.
Original complete36 trusted selected-state admission and owner/child/group/CUDA closure.
Use only the already required selected-state eval/no_grad member calls; preserve actual selected local/global modes.

sampling.population: All original observed graph rows; no labels, role masks, logits, correctness, features, learned scales or outcomes used for sampling.
prospective_algorithm: Create a separate Python stdlib random.Random(20261009); never use or change model/global RNG.
Draw 128 row indices uniformly without replacement from range(11701), then sort them.
Draw 1024 ranks uniformly without replacement from the 341376 lexicographically ordered three-element combinations of the 128 sorted rows.
Draw 1024 ranks uniformly without replacement from the 8128 lexicographically ordered two-element combinations of the same rows.
Lexicographically unrank each sampled combination; retain rank draw order and the sorted row list. No complete affinity or complete triangle list is required.
Store and hash the exact indices and generation source in a separate prospective sample seal before comparative outcome access.
sampling.same_samples_for: Every operator/family/seed/member/layer/head; do not resample per actual state.
sampling.triangle_orientation: i<j<k; evaluate i→j→k→i. Signed values depend on this arbitrary fixed orientation.

scientific_scope: Conditional intrinsic global core of each actual selected member/layer/head; floating observations alone are not whole-predictor expressivity or causal mediation.

structural_cost.buffers: Process one active slot with bounded chunk buffers; Float64 conversion and reduction buffers are additional to the Float32 row-transfer bound.
structural_cost.dot_work_per_active_slot: O((6T+4B)*512), T=B=1024 if the optional pair diagnostic is included.
